newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere says bid waiver on Filipacchi rejected.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere says bid waiver on Filipacchi rejected.

text.p: A Paris court rejected bourse regulator CMF's decision to waive a bid requirement by Lagardere Group for all of Filipacchi Medias as part of a plan to combine its media activities with those of Filipacchi, Lagardere said.
It said in a statement that the court ruled that such a waiver could not be granted before the annual general meeting of shareholders of Filipacchi Medias, scheduled for June 18.
"Groupe Lagardere will announce its intentions regarding a public offer on Filipacchi Medias shares in a statement soon," it said.

Lagardere proposed on April 3 to combine the media operations by acquiring 39 percent of NEMM, which holds 49.7 percent of Filipacchi Medias, and bring to Filipacchi Medias its 66 percent holding in Hachette Filipacchi Presse. Lagardere calculated it would hold 66 percent of Hachette Filipacchi Medias.
